name: pricing-table
useFor: Use on the pricing page, or as a section of the home page. Pass `plans` (monthly and yearly prices, or a quote) and mark one `featured`. Every other plan gets an outlined key.
source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): PricingPlans and pricing.css (plan row, one billing switch for every paid plan)
title: Pricing table
description: Plans in cut frames: price in the display size with its unit in DM Mono, the included usage, solid-node bullets; the featured plan has a Forest line and the one Forest key, and one switch bills every plan yearly.
